text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A question, Trainer. Do you like...
bowls?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Specifically speaking... rice bowls.

Type—marinated. Main
ingredient—salmon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I came across an item reduced for quick
sale. It
was in the seafood section... a
three-pack of
fillets.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy... granted me use of her recipe
book.
The flavor came out acceptable,
and I
successfully aided in the fillets'
quick sale.
